subject: Color tree by tip labels not node labels

messages.author: 0c48df4c5c6db621
messages.subject: Color tree by tip labels not node labels
parts:
I've checked the vignette but can't find a clear answer to this. Is there any way of coloring branches by tip label and not nodes?

I have a categorical vector the same length as tip.labels but it throws an error as it's looking for a vector the same length as nodes.


Example: 

beast_tree <- as.phylo(beast_tree)

cat <- as.data.frame(sample(c("present","absent"), 76, replace=TRUE))
row.names(cat) <- beast_tree$tip.label

ggtree(beast_tree, aes(color= cat)) 

Error: Aesthetics must be either length 1 or the same as the data (151): colour
